crashPointNote: Every trial deliberately crashes after the outside write is visible and before its result is recorded — the hardest window. This is one row of a five-row crash-point board, not a claim that peers always double-charge.
metric: duplicates + interrupted_or_unknown + completed_exactly_once; both upstream modes; agent policies (never/always/real/structural)
honesty: Crash-during-outside-write board. ClawQL structural refusal vs Pi Durable model-dependent retry. harnessValid = protocol ran correctly, not product-goodness. Pi zero-dup never-retry depends on the faux model; always-retry shows the worst case. Named public co-branded boards still need maintainer invite.

arms.honesty: ClawQL structural (crash during outside write). API types: idempotency_keys → 0/0/N via keyed resume; neither (no keys, no lookup) → 0/N/0 — the honest floor. Agent policy does not matter for re-send — the gate already consumed the approval.
